$comment: The branch ruleset this repository declares for its default branch — the GitHub-side
half of .github/required-checks.json, written down instead of remembered.
WHY IT EXISTS. ADR-0011 enumerated what may stop a change and built a gate
(scripts/merge-gate.mjs) that keeps the enumeration honest about the REPOSITORY: every
named check must exist, run on pull requests, keep its display name, and still be able
to fail. It said plainly what it could not do: 'the list can lie about GitHub's
settings, because nothing here can read them without a token.' So from outside this
repository the rubric review was indistinguishable from a review that merely comments —
the teeth were readable from inside the tree and nowhere else.
This file is the missing side. It is a literal GitHub Rulesets API payload: the
required status checks below are exactly the `check` strings in
.github/required-checks.json, and `npm run merge-gate` (blocking, inside
`npm run check:ci`, therefore inside .husky/pre-push) fails when the two drift apart.
Adding a required check and forgetting this file is a red build, not a silent gap.
APPLY IT (the operator, once — it needs the network and an admin token). The `$comment`
key is documentation, not part of the payload, so strip it on the way out:
jq 'del(.["$comment"])' .github/branch-ruleset.json |
gh api --method POST repos/xkazm04/systedo-case/rulesets --input -   # first time
jq 'del(.["$comment"])' .github/branch-ruleset.json |
gh api --method PUT repos/xkazm04/systedo-case/rulesets/<id> --input -   # thereafter
gh api repos/xkazm04/systedo-case/rulesets --jq '.[] | "\(.id) \(.name)"'   # find <id>
VERIFY IT (anyone with read access, and weekly in CI):
npm run protection:verify                      # needs `gh`, reads the live rules
.github/workflows/agent-review-history.yml runs that verification every Monday and
publishes the answer into the trail issue, so 'is the rubric review actually required?'
has a linkable answer that nobody has to take on faith. It is REPORTING rung (ADR-0007)
and permanently so: it needs a token, so it can never sit in check:ci.
BYPASS, DELIBERATELY. `bypass_actors` grants repository admins an always-bypass.
docs/deploy.md § Delivery contract records that master ships to Vercel ON PUSH and the
maintainer pushes directly; without this entry the ruleset would refuse the release act
itself. What governs the maintainer is .husky/pre-push, which runs the same blocking set
locally. Removing the bypass is a deployment-model change, not a hardening tweak.
This file is a law file in the sense of .github/CODEOWNERS: shrinking the list of
required checks here is a governance change and should be reviewed as one.
name: default branch — required checks
